name: catchmycall
description: Work your business phone and WhatsApp from the assistant: calls, leads, contacts and WhatsApp campaigns through the CatchMyCall connector.

interface.longDescription: CatchMyCall runs a business's AI phone agents and WhatsApp. Connect your CatchMyCall account to review which calls came in and what the AI agent captured, read call transcripts, find a contact and their WhatsApp history, work with leads (correct a misheard detail, set a pipeline status, export a list), check how a WhatsApp campaign performed, and, with your confirmation, place a call or send a WhatsApp message from your business's own numbers. You can also check and record do-not-contact requests. Every read and write is limited to the organisation you sign in to, and you approve exactly which permissions the app gets when you connect. A CatchMyCall account is required (sign up at app.catchmycall.ai). CatchMyCall is a business-communications product and is not designed for medical records.
defaultPrompt: Which calls did we miss yesterday, and did the AI agent capture a lead from any of them?
Show this week's new leads and export them as a CSV.
How did our last WhatsApp campaign do: sent, delivered, read, replied?
